name: claude-mods
description: Personal Claude Code mods: turn notifications and a colored session status band

plugins.name: turn-notify
plugins.description: Toast and sound when Claude finishes a turn or needs your input

plugins.name: session-status
plugins.description: One row of status dots above the prompt, in Catppuccin (Latte on light, Macchiato on dark): on desktop the row is one SVG with a rounded capsule, a colored dot per segment and small progress bars; on the terminal, text dots and text bars. Work item (its Azure DevOps title on hover), a red lock while a Predecessor work item is not done yet (read-only), git branch, branch sync (ahead/behind its upstream, from local refs, no fetch), the branch's Azure DevOps pull request state (read-only, Azure DevOps repos only), each with a plain-language hover, the work item's step from the running prosuite command (refine, código, review, prueba), active-time timer and subagent counts, then context (token count on hover) and CPU/RAM/temperature (Windows only); plus a session title with the work item title (needs the Azure CLI, read-only)
